tools.name: cash.create_transaction
tools.description: Record a manual cash transaction (income or expense) for the current user.

tools.name: cash.update_transaction
tools.description: Update fields on an existing manual cash transaction. Currency is locked - delete and recreate to change it.

tools.name: cash.delete_transaction
tools.description: Delete a manual cash transaction. Auto-generated rows (e.g. ATM linker) cannot be deleted here.

tools.name: transactions.list
tools.description: List ledger entries (bank + manual) with filters. Returns at most `limit` rows (default 25, max 200).

tools.name: transactions.get
tools.description: Fetch a single ledger entry by source type + id.

tools.name: transactions.classify
tools.description:
Apply a merchant + category to a bank transaction.
mode=only_this writes the override on this row only.
mode=all_for_merchant sets merchant.default_category - all rows for the merchant inherit.
mode=create_rule creates a user-source MerchantRule (rule_field/rule_kind/rule_pattern required) and rebuilds enrichment.

tools.name: categories.list
tools.description: List the user's categories. Hierarchy is encoded in `path` (ltree dot-separated).

tools.name: categories.create
tools.description: Create a new category. parent_path is the ltree path of the parent ('food.cooking' etc.); omit for top-level.

tools.name: categories.update
tools.description: Update / move a category. Changing parent_path rewrites paths of all descendants atomically.

tools.name: categories.archive
tools.description: Archive a category - kept in storage but hidden from active lists.

tools.name: categories.unarchive
tools.description: Restore a previously archived category.

tools.name: merchants.list
tools.description: List the user's merchants. Default: active only, name ASC, max 100 rows.

tools.name: merchants.create
tools.description: Create a user-source merchant. Slug auto-generated when omitted.

tools.name: merchants.update
tools.description: Update editable fields of a merchant.

tools.name: merchants.archive
tools.description: Archive a merchant - keeps history visible, hides from active selectors.

tools.name: merchants.unarchive
tools.description: Restore a previously archived merchant.

tools.name: merchants.approve
tools.description: Approve an LLM-suggested merchant. Enables its disabled rules and rebuilds enrichment for the user.

tools.name: bank_accounts.list
tools.description: List the user's bank accounts (synced from AISP) and cash wallets (manual=true).

manual.description: true → only cash wallets, false → only synced. Omit for both.

tools.name: bank_accounts.refresh_details
tools.description: Pull fresh account-info from the AISP provider (name, holder, product). Live API call.

tools.name: bank_accounts.refresh_balances
tools.description: Pull fresh balances from the AISP provider. Live API call.

tools.name: bank_connections.list
tools.description: List the user's bank connections with status + validity.

tools.name: bank_connections.refresh
tools.description: Pull current status + validity for a bank connection from the provider.

tools.name: analytics.cash_flow
tools.description: Spend + income totals and a date-bucketed series for the requested period. Defaults to month-to-date.

tools.name: analytics.spend
tools.description: Spend breakdown by category path with previous-period delta. depth=1 → top-level, depth=2 → mid-level, omit for leaf rows.

tools.name: analytics.top_merchants
tools.description: Top spend merchants for the period.

tools.name: transaction_syncs.create
tools.description: Queue a background transaction sync. Subject = a single bank connection (when bank_connection_id is given) or all of the user's active connections.

tools.name: llm_enrichments.create
tools.description: Queue an LLM enrichment run. The user must have an LLM provider configured in Preferences.

limit.description: Max distinct title groups to send to the LLM
